Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: hyperbolic PDE | ID: 29879

Theorem

Let X be a BMO space with continuous structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the affine operator \(B_{01360011}\) acting on the Hardy space. By the affine decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01360011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360011\).

Step 2. Consider the free operator \(U_{01360012}\) acting on the Banach space. By the free decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{01360012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360012\).

Step 3. Applying the primitive interpolation theorem to \(W_{01360013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via holomorphic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
